name: Brat s magicheskim zhezlom
source:
You, the main character, decided to skip school after having adult fun with the girl next door. When you return home, you didn't expect to find your sister at home, and now something incredible awaits you!
Your new life begins. 
Become the most powerful man in the world.
translation:
你，主角，在与邻家女孩享受成人乐趣后决定逃学。当你回到家时，你没想到会在家里找到你的妹妹，现在不可思议的事情正在等待着你！
你的新生活开始了。
成为世界上最有权势的人。
